description: Safe debloating lists for OnePlus, Oppo, and Realme devices running Android 11, 12, 13, and 14.

safe_telemetry_and_trackers.description: Background telemetry, push ad daemons, and crash reporters. 100% safe to disable with zero loss of daily functionality.

packages.name: HeyTap Cloud Messaging
packages.notes: Delivers push ads and tracking; consumes ~250MB RAM.

packages.name: Oppo DeepThinker AI Engine
packages.notes: Predictive AI resource hog; consumes ~70MB RAM.

packages.name: Silent App Auto-Update
packages.notes: Auto-installs system app updates without user prompts.

packages.name: ROM Config Auto-Update
packages.notes: Pushes OTA carrier and region config updates.

packages.name: 5G NR Mode Configurator
packages.notes: Redundant 5G network polling (safe to disable especially on 4G phones).

oem_optional_features.description: OEM add-ons that can be disabled if not actively used.

packages.name: Game Space / Game Center
packages.notes: Gaming overlay tool with promotional banners.

packages.name: OnePlus Weather
packages.notes: Built-in weather app with background location polling.

universal_system_utilities.description: Android system utilities that most users do not need.

packages.name: Android Print Spooler
packages.notes: Printer queue daemon (disable if not printing wirelessly from phone).

packages.name: Print Service Recommendations
packages.notes: Constantly probes Wi-Fi networks for wireless printers.
